pin.longFormSummary:
Completed battery storage facility

  • Vaughan 3 is a 40 MW/160 MWh battery energy storage facility at 6531 Rutherford Road, Vaughan, Ontario, Canada, connected at 27.6 kV. It is one of three Alectra–Convergent projects which the issuer announced as operational on November 6, 2026.
  • The partners won the three IESO Expedited Long-Term 1 contracts in 2023. The completed facilities operate under 20-year IESO contracts. Stored electricity is released during high demand; this is storage capacity, not an electricity-generation rating.

Project timeline

  • A December 6, 2024 regulatory notice expected construction in Q1 2025 and commercial operation in Q4 2025. Those were historical plans.
  • The July 17, 2025 OEB decision said construction of Vaughan 3 had begun; it did not publish an exact groundbreaking day. The then-stated operation target was January 2026. These targets do not establish the actual operation day.
  • The site-specific storage licence was issued on 2026-07-30. The later November 6 announcement explicitly confirmed operation; the exact commercial-operation date remains unpublished.

Cost and location precision

  • The opened issuer and regulator sources publish no plant-level capital cost; price and currency remain unset. No share of another programme total is allocated to this plant.
  • The map marker is an estimated address geocode for the licensed street address, not a verified battery-container footprint. No reviewed site polygon is available.
